Which Sources Do AI Engines Cite? Agenzy 2026 Study. Opens in new tab.

answer_text:
According to published research from Surfer AI Search Analytics, Perplexity generated approximately 10.37 million citations across 978,402 answers tracked between September 1 and September 28, 2026. Positive Surfer
The study, published in The 50 Most-Cited Domains in Perplexity, notes that while the top 50 most-cited domains (led heavily by platforms like Reddit and various review directories) captured 932,325 of those citations, they only represented 9% of the overall total. The remaining 91% of Perplexity's citations went to millions of unique, niche-specific, and local domains outside of that top-50 list, highlighting Perplexity's reliance on localized web sources for business recommendations. Positive Surfer
If you would like to explore further, I can provide details on:
The top-performing review and directory platforms (like Clutch and Yelp) cited in the study.
How Perplexity’s citation volume compares to other AI models like ChatGPT or Gemini. Agenzy +1
